Keychain and other system services are unreachable because the profile allows no mach-lookup; no keychain call was made.
sandbox-exec is deprecated by Apple but present; Crew 0.12.2 ships its own Seatbelt launcher, so the mechanism is in use on this platform.

Crew's default agent.sandbox setting wraps kiro-cli in sandbox-exec on macOS, so an MCP server it starts is already sandboxed and cannot apply this profile itself (Crew's own setting text: nested seatbelt causes EPERM).

unverified.claim: The installed Haunted House backend can apply a sandbox, i.e. Crew does not already run it inside one (a nested sandbox-exec fails).
unverified.manual_step: With the app installed and trusted, call the backend's startup confinement canary (run_confined on /usr/bin/touch outside the Mansion must be refused, inside must succeed) and read the result from the signed status route.

verified: A deny-default Seatbelt profile lets one exact argv read and write below the Mansion and refuses reads and writes of a sibling Mansion, a credential-shaped file, the real home listing, and Protected_Paths inside the Mansion.
Loopback connect and bind are refused inside the sandbox and succeed in the control.
Without process-fork the command cannot create any child, so nothing can outlive it.
A nested sandbox-exec cannot loosen the policy; it fails to apply.
Reads and writes through a symbolic link that leaves the Mansion are refused.
A hard link that already sits inside the Mansion defeats the path-based sandbox; the runner's pre-start scan refuses to start, and the sandbox refuses to create such a link.
The child sees only the runner's fixed environment; the working directory is validated before start; a timeout kills the command's process group.
With process-fork allowed, a child that calls setsid outlives the runner, although it stays inside the same sandbox.

guidance.delete_path: Independent of S10: an in-process Path_Guard operation, no child process.
guidance.fallback: On a host without sandbox-exec, or when the startup canary fails, command and git return confinement_unavailable without starting a process.
guidance.git_write: Only add and commit through the no-fork profile with the real git binary, -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null, -c core.fsmonitor=false, -c gc.auto=0, -c commit.gpgsign=false, identity from trusted configuration, and .git writable only for this action kind. Enabled only when the git checks below are true on the host.
guidance.hard_links: Refuse to start while any regular file below the Mansion has more than one link, in addition to Path_Guard's per-file check.
guidance.run_command: Only through the no-fork profile: absolute allowlisted executable, exact argv, fixed environment, guarded cwd, timeout, bounded output. A command that must spawn children returns confinement_unavailable; do not offer a fork-allowed mode.
guidance.runner_location: Run confined actions from the app backend process, behind a startup canary. A process that is already sandboxed cannot apply a second sandbox, so an MCP server started by a sandboxed kiro-cli must ask the backend through the capability-bound operation instead of spawning the command itself.
